title: Captain Piedaterre's Blunders
author: Wade Clarke
description:
"You are Captain Piedaterre, proud rat, scourge of a good number of seas and collector of amazing things that people forget to nail down and don't seem to care about when they go missing."

Captain Piedaterre's Blunders is a short CYOA spin-off of Ryan Veeder's popular 2013 ship-looting game Captain Verdeterre's Plunder.
